scenario_prompt: Write the risk section of a solution proposal, naming each material risk and what is done about it, and stating plainly any risk that cannot be fully retired rather than omitting it. Context: the buyer's RFP requires a SOC 2 Type II report and the bidder holds only a SOC 2 Type I report today, with the Type II observation window closing after the RFP's submission date; separately, the bidder's own most comparable prior migration took 11 months, close to the buyer's 6-month compliance-audit deadline. Return only the risk section text.
text:
**Artifact family: a proposal section.**

No customer source material (RFP question text, discovery notes, stated requirements) was supplied for this task beyond the two facts given, so `PF-3.3` cannot fire on any term below — every term is judged by the deletion test alone.

## Risks

**SOC 2 Type II gap.** The RFP requires a SOC 2 Type II report. We hold a SOC 2 Type I report today. A Type II report requires an observation period, and our current observation window closes after the RFP's submission date. We cannot deliver a Type II report by that date, and this risk is not retired. `[PF-2.17 REVIEW (compliance): confirm current SOC 2 Type I scope, coverage period, and the exact date our Type II observation window closes, before this section ships]` To reduce exposure, we propose: sharing our Type I report and the Type II audit engagement letter at submission, so the buyer can see the control scope now; and delivering the completed Type II report on the first date the observation window allows. `[PF-1.13 GAP: the exact date the Type II report will be available is not yet fixed — needs confirmation from our audit firm]`

**Migration schedule risk.** The buyer's compliance-audit deadline is 6 months from contract start. `[PF-1.14: buyer's stated compliance-audit deadline]` Our most comparable prior migration took 11 months. `[PF-2.2: internal delivery record for that migration]` An 11-month comparable against a 6-month deadline is a gap we cannot close by assertion, and this risk is not retired. `[PF-2.14 REVIEW (commitment): confirm before this ships whether we are prepared to commit to the 6-month date, or must propose a revised milestone to the buyer]` We propose narrowing the gap by: sequencing the buyer's compliance-critical systems first, so the components the audit depends on complete inside the 6-month window even where the full migration continues beyond it; and reviewing the specific differences between the prior 11-month engagement and this one — scope, data volume, buyer-side resourcing — in discovery, so the plan reflects this migration and not the average of the last one. `[PF-1.17 GAP: the discovery findings that would show this migration's scope is smaller or larger than the 11-month comparable are not yet available]`

## Unresolved before this document is sent

| Marker | Rule | What is needed |
|---|---|---|
| SOC 2 Type II scope/coverage/window-close date | PF-2.17 | Confirmation from our audit firm of Type I scope, coverage period, and the exact date the Type II observation window closes |
| Type II report availability date | PF-1.13 | A fixed date for Type II report delivery, once the observation window is known |
| Commitment to the 6-month deadline | PF-2.14 | A decision on whether to commit to 6 months or propose a revised milestone to the buyer |
| Discovery comparison to the 11-month engagement | PF-1.17 | Discovery findings on scope, data volume, and buyer-side resourcing versus the prior comparable migration |
